correctness.rationale: Odd-characteristic two-to-one quotient count and elementary bilinear orthogonality yield exact positive real Gram entries. The complete Johnson incidence decomposition yields all eigenvalues and eigenspaces. Direct character tests over prime and extension fields, plus exact symbolic determinant identities, support the proof. The threshold follows from a proved exponential-versus-linear integer inequality; the finite tests are not treated as an infinite proof. A direct restriction-to-two-coordinate-vectors argument establishes linear independence for all permitted parameters.

value.rationale: The canonical Veronese rank-one cone encodes all pairwise interaction coordinates; selecting every nontrivial additive character of each off-diagonal entry gives a natural Fourier measurement band. The exact Riesz constants, complete equality spaces and sharp dimension crossover between a Johnson cycle mode and a coupled constant mode have independent spectral meaning. The cubic condition-number law, with exact leading coefficient, clarifies stability limits. This is not a routine renamed pre-existing spectral table or an arbitrary small computation.
